Purpose: Three bounded live helper acceptance groups; not full module or checklist signoff.

Items.Description: Exact-owned Task View entry and finally cleanup

Assertions.Description: A test-opened Task View is identified, normally dismissed and returns to the exact owned foreground.
An injected observation error still dismisses only the test-opened Task View and preserves the original error.

Items.Description: Template-dependent defaults and exact selected-default capture

Assertions.Description: Changing a template count through UI settles the template and its referencing orientation-default records without unrelated changes.
A reopened creation-owned custom layout exposes the selected default control and its complete identity-bound crop.

Items.Description: Reduced geometry and patterned transparency observation

Assertions.Description: A real zones-1-2 assignment fits the one-zone layout and returns to its original geometry/index set without assuming reduced mask 1.
A real transparent drag exposes the patterned owned background; normal opacity returns on cancellation, with before/during/after pixels and native evidence.
